newsitem.title: USA: Ohio sees slight dip in August jobless rate.
newsitem.headline: Ohio sees slight dip in August jobless rate.

text.p: - Ohio's August unemployment rate dropped slightly to 4.6 percent from 4.8 percent in July, according to the Ohio Bureau of Employment Services.
The number of unemployed workers fell to 262,000 last month from 274,000 in July, the bureau reported Friday.

"The slight drop in the unemployment rate over the month is primarily due to manufacturing regaining some of the job losses experienced during July," said Debra Bowland, the bureau's director in a news release. "We also saw an increase in government employment, particularly local schools -- a commong pattern for the month of August."
Ohio unemployment rate in August 1995 was five percent.
